chapters.label: Berlin, 2024
chapters.text: Berlin, 2024, the Euro final. At half time, Rodri was hurt, so calm Martín Zubimendi came on. Spain beat England, two-one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: This is how he does it. The other team wants to pass forward to their striker. Martín stands right in the path. The ball has to go through him, and he wins it!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. As the passer moves, Martín slides across to stay in the line. Then, a calm, simple pass.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: stand where the forward pass has to go through you, not around you.
